content: Imet itiwik nunga den pangan
“Tom mu te duruk wonong ko kingdom mu imet itiwik 10 pela nunga lam giman, ale kari bo imet taukko tairukko wore arigimonko namakasan wore turan.
Se nunga ningi 5 pela mu nunga ikia ngualara ago, se 5 tala mu ikia sinar ago.
Se ikia ngualara ago mu nunga lam giman, bare karasin sang me giman.
Se imet ikia sinar ago mu nunga lam se karasin sang ago giman.
Bare kari imet taukko mu pasak me taikaso, se nuna kimi bita laga nomotam aniram se aniwaman.
“Se tirom uriluan aira bo tairam, ‘Kari imet taukko mu tai aratam iweya! Aratal ale arigalko!’ mam.
“Se imet itiwik mu suen la barasaman nunga lam giman ale kasaman ale motam nunguru burangikasan.
Se 5 pela ikia ngualara ago mu 5 tala ikia sinar ago mu nunga manarukasan, ‘Nengete karasin sang nangaralko. Anananga lam irisan pa!’ maman.

“Bare 5 pela ikia sinar ago mu balukasan, ‘Mena,’ makasan. ‘Karasin imi ana sang ningarnakko me terong, anananga lam ko la terong mam. Nina diara kawam te namaral ale nemeke kala ninga lam ko karasin diaralko.’

“Se imet itiwik ngualara ago mu karasin diamonko namawaman, se nubiring ko kari imet taukko mu tai aratam. Se imet itiwik sinar bagaman mu kari imet numi giokko mu ilak inang biya mu ko kasu nagu gilingiman. Se songkuring baguman.
“Se udagi imet itiwik ikia ngualara ago mu taiman ale aikasan, ‘Kari dom! Kari dom!’ makasan. ‘Ana nago ko songkuring kaguruko!’ makasan.
“Bare nu nunga maonam, ‘Ani nunguningta ninga manorsam, ani nina me ninga ikisam,’ mam.
“Bore te se, nina pempem sinar la lagaralko, nina Kari ko Namar ko day tom agi ko worem motam awilaya mu te tairukko, mu nina me ko ikisan.
Kari dom se ko ura kari ilagala suan nunga den pangan
“Se aking duruk wonong ko kingdom mu, kari dom bo aolak bo awar iluwokko se, nu ko ura kari nunga auram se taiman, se ko melmasak suen la bitaru se bagamonko nuguting te bita bita ago namaram.
Nu ura kari suan suan nunga ikia nunga nosokel te iki iki manga nungaru nungaru ago namaram. Bo 5000 kina tuam, bo 2000 kina tuam, se bo mu 1000 kina tuam. Asele nu barasam namakaso.
Se ura kari 5000 kina tam, mu nu tairate namaram ale manga mu ura te beteram, ale ko marir manga 5000 kina tala awote tam.
Se ura kari 2000 kina tam mu nu koma suanta tala ura te beteram, ale ko marir manga 2000 kina tala awote tam.
Bare ura kari 1000 kina tam, mu giam karogo namaram mutim bo iram, ale ko kari dom mu ko manga ningi kaluwu beteram.
“Se kari dom mu lagaram tom sapa laga asele peleram tairam, ale manga nungaram mu nongorak nunguru burangikaso.

Se ura kari 5000 kina tam mu nu tairam, ale 5000 kina bo tala awote tam mu karogo ko kari dom mu kausam ale balam, ‘Kari dom, arikko,’ mam. ‘Ni ani 5000 kina aisem mu ani ura te beterem, ale 5000 kina bo tala awote taem, ale biguwurem 10,000 iwo,’ mam ale tuam.

“Se ko kari dom mu maonam, ‘Ni ura kari ningo, ni yawarakala nunguningkiri beterem!’ mam. ‘Ni ura gotek imi gemang ningi nunguningkiri te ko sinar taem. Se ani melmasak singir biya kiting te bitirik se ko sinar to se, tair ale aninga amilmil ningi agarak bagerko.’
“Asele kari 2000 kina tam mu betelatala tairam ale mam, ‘Kari dom,’ mam, ‘ni 2000 kina ani aisem mu ani ura te beterem, ale 2000 kina bo tala awote taem ale biguwurem 4000 kina mu iweya,’ mam.

“Se ko kari dom mu maonam, ‘Ni ura kari ningo, ni yawarakala nunguningkiri beterem!’ mam. ‘Ni ura gotek imi gemang ningi nunguningkiri te ko sinar taem. Se ani melmasak singir biya kiting te bitirik se ko sinar to se, tair ale aninga amilmil ningi agarak bagerko,’ mam.

“Asele ura kari 1000 kina tam mu tairam ale mam, ‘Kari dom, ani ikisam mu ni kari aora biya, ni awiriya ko ningam wore am ningi gi nasam, ni ningam bo ningi inang muguri me warem bare mu betelatala ningi ko nunguning am gi ilu biguwusam tala.
Bore te se ani nguangerem, ale manga 1000 kina ni ani aisem mu karogo namerem mutim irem, ale ningi kaluwurem. Se aitak nika manga mu diram la karogo tairem iweya,’ mam.

“Se ko kari dom mu iwita maonam, ‘Ni ura kari memek, gagor gurum! Ni aga balem ani kari sang nunga ningam te am gi nasam, maem e? Aking kari sang ningam te na muguri agusan mu ani ko nunguning am gi ilu biguwusam, maem e?
Ni uwuta ikiem agi mu, awuk se ni aninga manga bank te me beterem? Ni uwuta beterem le mu, ani pelerem tairem ale manga mu to se ko marir manga karogo taem le.’
“‘Buta se tairal manga kuting te tal ale ura kari manga 10,000 tam mu kuting te beteralko,’ mam.

Mu awuk, awiriya mel karogo mu, nuna sang karogotala tumon se nu mel terong ma la ago bagarukko. Bare awiriya mel mena mu, katirta gotek kumik te aniso mu kumik te gi sapamon se kumik mel mena biya bagarukko.
Butata se kari memek sumu tal ale matangi sor tiromorom ningi saparal se mu te baga se, kore gigek ma se nia kika se bagarukko.
Sipsip se goat
“Tom Kari ko Namar mu ko nikinang biya mu ningi ko engel alo nongorak tairuk, mu nu ko daiga kuwim nup ago nikim biya mu te daigokko.

Se ali sor suen biya ko kariimet tai koma dugu te bolala awumon, se nu sipsip se goat bolala bagasan se nunga pagaru kirker nunga awusan iwitatala, kariimet nunga pagaru kirker motam ilagala nunga awurokko.
Ale sipsip mu ko kuting sengam mu te nunga awurok, ale goat mu kuting ngas mu te nunga awurokko.

“Asele King mu kariimet ko kuting sengam mu te anisan mu iwita nunga manuk, ‘Nina kariimet aninga Ait ninga amilmiloso mu tairal ale kingdom, ali mel suen la me arata la nenenga balu se nunguru beteram, mu talko.
Mu awuk, ani na ko kuerem mu nina ani na aisiman se naem, se ani yu ko kuerem mu nina yu aisiman se naem. Se ani kari iwareng bo iwita tairem mu nina ani aga aru tagiman ale kuwim aisiman.

Se ani guang yamel ko tukunangarem se nina ani guang yamel te aga angimik ereman. Se ani kuera karogo bagerem, mu nina aninga sinar taman. Se ani talipara ningi bagerem mu nina tai agarkaman,’ maukko.
“Se kariimet ningo diram mu iwita nu isarmonko, ‘Kari Biya, tom awuk wore te ni na ko kuerem se ana karkaman ale na kisiman? Ale yu ko kuerem se ana yu kisiman?
Se ana tom awuk wore te ni kari iwareng ko iwita tairem se ana ka aru tagi kuwim kisiman? Agi guang ko tukunangarem se ana guang yamel te kimik ereman?
Ale aking tom awuk wore te ni kuera karogo bagerem se ana nika sinar taman? Agi talipara kawam ningi bagerem se ana tai karkaman?’ mamon.
“Se King mu mauk, ‘Ani nunguningta ninga manorsam, nina anapeya aninga launuria kituwura bo kumik te beteman, mu nina ani angimik te beteman,’ ma balukko.

“Asele nu kariimet kuting ngas mu te anisan mu iwita nunga manuk, ‘Nina kariimet memek alo, se ani amakete tagi tal, ale nama tama, Satan se ko engel alo nunga nunguru beteman se pempem la kani lagoso, mu ningi kapa saparalko.
Mu awuk, ani na ko kuakasam, bare nina ani na me aisukasan, yu ko kuakasam mu yu me aisukasan.

Ani kari iwareng ko iwita taikasam, bare nina me aga aru tagikasan ale kuwim aisukasan. Ani guang yamel ko tukunangakasam, bare nina guang yamel bo te angimik me irakasan. Se aking kuera karogo bagakasam agi talipara kawam ningi bagakasam mu nina tai me agarkikasan,’ maukko.

“Se nuna betela iwita balmon, ‘Kari Biya, ni amaru na inang ko kuakasam agi yu ko kuakasam agi, kari iwareng ko iwita taikasam agi, kuera karogo bagakasam agi talipara kawam ningi bagakasam se ana me ka sangarukasan?’ mamon.

“Se King mu iwita nunga manukko, ‘Ani nunguningta ninga manorsam, tom nina munan ningo bo aninga launuria kituwura bo kumik te me beteman, mu nina ani angimik te koma suanta tala beteman,’ ma nunga manukko.

“Se nuna namamon ale kuwim memek mu ningi yaman memek tom suen biya to se lagamonko. Bare kariimet ningo diram mu namamon ale kuwim marak ningo yawara tom suen biya te bagamonko mu ningi amilmil te baga se lagamonko.”

footnotes.text: Sipsip imet taukko ko den: Revelation 19:6-19.
Saonga ningo saki alo nungumik te betera: Proverbs 19:17; Matthew 10:42; Hebrews 6:10; 13:3.
